description: This file implements a FastAPI router for payment-related endpoints, including creating checkout sessions, handling webhooks, and retrieving payment history. It defines schemas, helper functions, and routes for managing payment workflows, currently in a stubbed or placeholder implementation intended for initial development and testing.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating checkout requests, including amount, currency, and reference.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutResponse
classes.description: Schema for responses when creating checkout sessions, including provider info, session IDs, and status.

classes.name: PaymentsListResponse
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of payments.

methods.name: CreateCheckoutResponse create_checkout( payload: CreateCheckoutRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a payment record and returns placeholders for checkout/session IDs, with logic for stub or real provider integration.

methods.name: dict stripe_webhook( request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db), stripe_signature: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Stripe-Signature"), )
methods.description: Webhook handler for payment provider events, updating payment statuses based on webhook data.

methods.name: PaymentsListResponse payment_history( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Users = Depends(get_current_user), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), )
methods.description: Fetches paginated payment history for the current user.

methods.name: PaymentsListResponse admin_payments( db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by status (pending/success/failed/refunded)"), user_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by specific user"), )
methods.description: Admin endpoint to view all payments with optional filtering.
